en.commentary: Liver health became one of the fastest moving corners of the supplement market this year, and I ranked this category on a single question: how much clinically meaningful active ingredient actually reaches your bloodstream per dollar spent. That question sorts eleven bottles very quickly. Thorne Milk Thistle Phytosome takes first place because silybin bound to phosphatidylcholine absorbs up to ten times better than standard silymarin extract, and absorption is the central problem with milk thistle. Silymarin has poor water solubility, so 180 mg of Siliphos puts more silybin into circulation than a much larger label claim on a conventional extract. Thorne backs that with four third-party certifications and an NSF Certified for Sport line that professional teams buy, which is the most demanding supply chain audit available to a consumer brand. TUDCA takes second place through Nutricost. The clinical window sits at 500 to 1,500 mg per day with 500 to 1,000 mg the most reliable range for liver markers, and 250 mg capsules at roughly twenty dollars for sixty servings make that dose easy to sustain for the months it takes for enzyme changes to appear. NAC earns its position on mechanism strength. The FDA approves it as the antidote for acetaminophen overdose, so its ability to protect hepatocytes by restoring glutathione is settled science, and 600 to 1,200 mg per day is the researched range. NOW sells that dose with selenium and molybdenum for about eighteen dollars per hundred capsules, the best cost per effective serving in the whole ranking. I place single-active formulas with printed milligram doses above multi-ingredient blends throughout this list, because a label that tells you exactly how much silybin or TUDCA sits in each capsule lets you match your intake to the studies. That transparency is what separates a supplement you can reason about from one you have to trust on faith.

highlights.title: Absorption decides this category, and phytosome milk thistle wins it outright
highlights.body: Silymarin dissolves poorly in water, which means most of a standard extract passes through without reaching the liver in useful amounts. Binding silybin to phosphatidylcholine changes the arithmetic completely, with clinical work showing Siliphos absorbed up to ten times better than conventional milk thistle extract. That is why a 180 mg phytosome capsule outperforms bottles carrying far bigger numbers on the front label. When you shop this category, read the extract form before you read the milligram count.

highlights.title: TUDCA is the most interesting liver active of 2026, and 500 mg per day is the number to hit
highlights.body: Tauroursodeoxycholic acid works through bile acid signalling, which is a completely different route from the antioxidant mechanism milk thistle uses. Published dosing sits between 500 and 1,500 mg per day, with the 500 to 1,000 mg band producing the most consistent movement in liver stress markers. Nutricost and Double Wood both sell 250 mg capsules, which is the right unit size because it lets you start at 250 mg, watch how you tolerate it, and step up to the clinical dose.

highlights.title: NAC has the strongest mechanistic evidence in the category because hospitals use it
highlights.body: The FDA approves N-acetyl cysteine as the antidote for acetaminophen overdose, and that approval rests on its ability to replenish hepatic glutathione fast enough to stop liver failure. No botanical in this ranking carries evidence of that weight. For daily support the researched range is 600 to 1,200 mg, which NOW covers at roughly eighteen dollars per hundred capsules with selenium and molybdenum included as glutathione cofactors. This is the highest evidence-to-cost ratio on the list.

highlights.title: Buy the actives you can count in milligrams
highlights.body: The formulas I rank highest all tell you exactly how much silybin, silymarin or TUDCA sits in each capsule, so you can compare your intake directly against the clinical literature. Jarrow standardizes its 30:1 extract to 80% total flavonoids, which means each 150 mg capsule delivers a verifiable 120 mg of silymarin. Nutricost and Double Wood both print 250 mg of TUDCA per capsule. That level of specificity turns a purchase into a calculation you can check.

highlights.title: Third-party testing is the cheapest insurance you can buy in a botanical category
highlights.body: Milk thistle is an agricultural crop, and crops concentrate whatever is in the soil, which makes heavy metal screening genuinely important here rather than a marketing checkbox. Thorne carries four separate third-party certifications and supplies NSF Certified for Sport products. Life Extension publishes a certificate of analysis for every lot. NOW operates its own analytical laboratories and releases assay data. Paying a few dollars more for a brand that documents what is in the bottle is the easiest good decision in this whole category.

zh-tw.commentary:
護肝這件事在台灣的文化剛需強度大概是全世界前段班，尾牙春酒、業務應酬、輪班熬夜，加上 B 型肝炎帶原比例本來就高，身邊十個人有八個抽屜裡放過護肝片。所以這份排行榜我只用一個問題來排：你每花一塊錢，有多少真正有臨床意義的有效成分進得了血液。這個問題一問下去，十一款的順序就很清楚了。

Thorne 的水飛薊 phytosome 拿第一，理由很單純，水飛薊賓和磷脂質結合之後吸收率是一般萃取的十倍。水飛薊素水溶性本來就差，所以 180 毫克的 Siliphos 送進循環的量，會比標示數字大得多的傳統萃取還多。Thorne 手上四張第三方認證，NSF Certified for Sport 那條線是職業運動隊在買的，這是消費品牌能做到最嚴的供應鏈稽核。

第二名我給 Nutricost 的 TUDCA。臨床用量落在一天 500 到 1,500 毫克，其中 500 到 1,000 毫克這一段對肝指標的反應最穩定，而 60 份不到台幣七百塊的價格，讓你有本錢連吃好幾個月。肝指標的變化本來就要用月來看，撐得下去才有意義。

NAC 的機轉強度是全場最硬的。FDA 核准它當普拿疼過量的解毒劑，靠的就是它補充肝臟穀胱甘肽的速度，一天 600 到 1,200 毫克是研究範圍。老實說，這裡有個台灣人一定要知道的事，NAC 在台灣被衛福部歸類為藥品成分，保健食品通路合法買不到，你在康是美或屈臣氏架上找不到它，得靠 iHerb 之類的海外管道自用進口。

整份榜單我都把「單方、有標示毫克數」排在複方前面，因為看得到每顆有多少水飛薊賓或多少 TUDCA，你才算得出自己吃的量對不對得上研究。

highlights.title: 吸收率決定這個品類的勝負，phytosome 劑型直接贏下來
highlights.body: 水飛薊素水溶性很差，一般萃取吃下去大部分是路過而已。把水飛薊賓和磷脂質結合成 phytosome 之後，整個算式就變了，臨床資料顯示 Siliphos 的吸收率可以到傳統水飛薊萃取的十倍。這就是為什麼 180 毫克的 phytosome 膠囊表現會贏過瓶身數字大得多的產品。說白了，逛這個品類的時候先看萃取劑型，再看毫克數。

highlights.title: TUDCA 是 2026 年最值得關注的護肝成分，一天 500 毫克是關鍵數字
highlights.body: TUDCA 走的是膽酸訊號路徑，跟水飛薊的抗氧化機轉是完全不同的兩條線。已發表的劑量落在一天 500 到 1,500 毫克，其中 500 到 1,000 毫克這一段對肝臟壓力指標的反應最一致。Nutricost 和 Double Wood 都做 250 毫克一顆，這個分裝單位很聰明，你可以先從一天 250 毫克試耐受度，適應之後再加到臨床劑量。

highlights.title: NAC 的機轉證據等級最高，因為醫院真的在用它救命
highlights.body: FDA 核准 N-乙醯半胱胺酸作為普拿疼過量的解毒劑，靠的是它補回肝臟穀胱甘肽的速度快到能擋下猛爆性肝衰竭，這份證據的份量在這份榜單裡沒有任何植物萃取比得上。日常保養的研究區間是一天 600 到 1,200 毫克。這裡要提醒台灣讀者，NAC 在國內被列為藥品成分，保健食品通路買不到，想用只能透過海外網購自用進口，或是走醫師處方。

highlights.title: 買那種你數得出毫克數的成分
highlights.body: 我排名最高的幾款都會明講每顆裡面有多少水飛薊賓、水飛薊素或 TUDCA，你才能拿自己吃的量直接對照臨床文獻。Jarrow 把 30:1 萃取標準化到 80% 總類黃酮，換算下來每顆 150 毫克裡是 120 毫克水飛薊素，這個數字驗算得出來。Nutricost 和 Double Wood 也都清楚印出每顆 250 毫克 TUDCA。這種具體程度，讓買保健品從賭運氣變成一道可以驗算的題目。

highlights.title: 第三方檢驗是植物萃取品類裡最便宜的保險
highlights.body: 水飛薊是農作物，農作物會把土壤裡的東西濃縮起來，所以重金屬檢驗在這個品類是真的有意義的事情。Thorne 有四張獨立第三方認證，還有 NSF Certified for Sport 產線。Life Extension 每一批都公開檢驗報告。NOW 自己養實驗室並對外釋出檢驗數據。為了看得到瓶子裡到底裝什麼多付幾百塊台幣，是這個品類裡最好做的一個決定。

en.commentary:
Thorne's Milk Thistle Phytosome stays at number one because it solves silymarin's central problem, which is absorption. Standard milk thistle extract is poorly absorbed, and Siliphos binds silybin to phosphatidylcholine to form a phytosome complex that crosses the intestinal wall far more effectively. A well-absorbed moderate dose beats a large dose that stays in your gut.

The comparison literature updated this year is worth reading carefully. A 2025 randomised crossover trial found that the bile-acid transport pathway TUDCA uses is substantially more efficient than passive flavonoid absorption, with micellar delivery raising systemic exposure roughly 2.5-fold over standard formulations. The practical summary from that work: when bile flow or endoplasmic reticulum stress is the limiting factor, TUDCA has the stronger mechanism. Milk thistle remains the well-evidenced antioxidant option at a much lower price.

That is why Nutricost TUDCA 250 sits second. Typical liver support dosing runs 250 to 500mg daily split across one or two doses, and Nutricost hits that range at the lowest cost per gram here.

NAC at fifth and eighth works through a different route entirely, replenishing glutathione. It is the one I would consider alongside rather than instead of the others. A note that matters: talk to your doctor before starting any of these if you have diagnosed liver disease or take prescription medication, because several of these interact.

highlights.title: Phytosome binding is what makes silymarin actually absorbable
highlights.body: Standard milk thistle extract absorbs poorly, so a large label dose can deliver very little systemically. Thorne's Siliphos binds silybin to phosphatidylcholine, forming a complex that crosses the intestinal wall far more effectively. When comparing milk thistle products, look at the delivery form before the milligram count, because absorption is where most of this category loses its dose.

highlights.title: TUDCA has the stronger mechanism when bile flow is the problem
highlights.body: A 2025 randomised crossover trial found the bile-acid transport pathway TUDCA uses to be substantially more efficient than passive flavonoid absorption, with micellar delivery raising systemic exposure roughly 2.5-fold. For endoplasmic reticulum stress and bile flow specifically, that is a mechanistic advantage milk thistle does not match. Match the compound to the problem rather than buying the most popular ingredient.

highlights.title: Nutricost delivers the studied dose at the lowest cost per gram
highlights.body: Typical liver support dosing runs 250 to 500mg of TUDCA daily, split into one or two doses, and TUDCA is expensive enough that price per gram determines whether you sustain a course. Nutricost hits the studied range at the best cost in this ranking. In a supplement requiring months of consistent use, cost per effective dose is a performance specification.

highlights.title: Talk to your doctor before starting if you take prescription medication
highlights.body: Silymarin, NAC and TUDCA each interact with common prescription drugs and with each other, and anyone with diagnosed liver disease needs a clinician involved rather than a supplement stack assembled from reviews. Get your liver enzymes measured before you start so you have a baseline. Supplements are a reasonable adjunct and a poor substitute for knowing what your numbers actually are.

zh-tw.commentary:
Thorne Milk Thistle Phytosome 還是第一，因為它解掉了水飛薊素最核心的問題：吸收。一般水飛薊萃取物吸收率很差，而 Siliphos 是把水飛薊賓跟磷脂醯膽鹼結合成植物體複合物，穿過腸壁的效率高出許多。一個吸收得好的中等劑量，勝過一個留在腸道裡的大劑量。

今年更新的比較文獻值得仔細讀。2025 年一項隨機交叉試驗發現，TUDCA 使用的膽酸運輸途徑，效率遠高於類黃酮的被動吸收，微胞化遞送讓全身暴露量比標準劑型提高約 2.5 倍。那份研究的實務結論是：當限制因素是膽汁流動或內質網壓力時，TUDCA 的機制比較強。水飛薊則依然是證據扎實、價格低很多的抗氧化選項。

這就是 Nutricost TUDCA 250 排第二的原因。一般肝臟支持劑量落在每天 250 到 500mg、分一到兩次，而 Nutricost 在這個區間的每克成本是這裡最低的。

第五跟第八名的 NAC 走的是完全不同的路徑，補充穀胱甘肽。它是我會考慮跟其他成分並用、而不是取代其他成分的那一個。有件事很重要：如果你有確診的肝臟疾病或正在服用處方藥，開始任何一種之前請先跟醫師討論，因為其中好幾種會產生交互作用。

highlights.title: 讓水飛薊素真的能被吸收的是植物體結合技術
highlights.body: 一般水飛薊萃取物吸收很差，所以標示上的大劑量實際進入全身循環的可能很少。Thorne 的 Siliphos 把水飛薊賓跟磷脂醯膽鹼結合，形成穿透腸壁效率高得多的複合物。比較水飛薊產品時，先看遞送形式再看毫克數，因為這個品類的劑量大多是在吸收這一關掉光的。

highlights.title: 當問題出在膽汁流動時，TUDCA 的機制比較強
highlights.body: 2025 年一項隨機交叉試驗發現，TUDCA 使用的膽酸運輸途徑效率遠高於類黃酮的被動吸收，微胞化遞送讓全身暴露量提高約 2.5 倍。單就內質網壓力跟膽汁流動而言，那是水飛薊比不上的機制優勢。用問題去對應成分，不要買最紅的那一個。

highlights.title: Nutricost 用最低的每克成本提供研究劑量
highlights.body: 一般肝臟支持的 TUDCA 劑量是每天 250 到 500mg 分一到兩次，而 TUDCA 貴到每克價格會直接決定你撐不撐得完一個療程。Nutricost 在研究劑量區間的成本是這份榜單最好的。一個需要連續吃好幾個月的補充品，每有效劑量的成本本身就是效能規格。

highlights.title: 有在吃處方藥的話，開始前先跟醫師討論
highlights.body: 水飛薊素、NAC 跟 TUDCA 各自都會跟常見處方藥產生交互作用，彼此之間也會，而有確診肝病的人需要的是臨床醫師介入，不是照著評測拼湊出來的補充組合。開始之前先驗肝功能指數，才有基準值。保健食品是合理的輔助，卻是很糟的「知道自己數字」的替代品。
